title: México y el TLCAN
goal: Read about the political shocks of 1994 -- the Zapatista uprising, the assassination of Luis Donaldo Colosio, and the peso crisis that followed NAFTA's entry into force.
grammar: A raíz de que: como consecuencia directa de que (algo ocurriera)

items: Explain what happened to Luis Donaldo Colosio.
Describe why Zedillo's government devalued the peso.
Explain what the "crisis del tequila" was.
Use a raíz de que to name the direct trigger of an event.
